items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.text_en: Ayat al-Kursi (Quran 2:255) — Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Ikhlas (Quran 112) — Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Falaq (Quran 113) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of whatever He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.text_en: Surah An-Nas (Quran 114) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.

items.text_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
items.text_en: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what comes after it.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.text_en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am bound to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. There is no god but You.

items.text_ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.text_en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, my family and my wealth.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
items.text_en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his shirk.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

items.text_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
items.text_en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.

items.text_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.text_en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify for me all my affairs and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.

items.text_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.text_en: We have entered the morning upon the fitrah of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the religion of our father Ibrahim, who was a Muslim and not of the polytheists.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.text_en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, as many times as the number of His creatures, in accordance with His good pleasure, equal to the weight of His Throne, and equal to the ink that may be used in recording the words for His Praise.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2726 — Read 3 times, heavier than all morning dhikr
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٧٢٦ - تقرأ ٣ مرات، أثقل من ذكر كله

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and acceptable deeds.
items.source_en: Sunan Ibn Majah 925 — Read after Fajr
items.source_ar: سنن ابن ماجه ٩٢٥ - تقال بعد الفجر

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.text_en: Allah, there is no god but Him, the Living, the Sustainer. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. (Ayat al-Kursi)

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ، لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.text_en: The Messenger believes in what has been revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. All believe in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers. We make no distinction between any of His messengers. They say: We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return. Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have the good it has earned, and it will bear the evil it has earned. Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden as You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Guardian, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 5009 — Last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah (285-286)
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٥٠٠٩ - آخر آيتين من سورة البقرة (٢٨٥-٢٨٦)

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Ikhlas (Quran 112) — Say: He is Allah, the One.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Falaq (Quran 113) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.text_en: Surah An-Nas (Quran 114) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.

items.text_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
items.text_en: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.text_en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me. And I seek refuge in Your greatness from being swallowed up from beneath me.
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٧٥، سنن ابن ماجه ٣٨٧١

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.text_en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him, as many times as the number of His creatures, in accordance with His good pleasure, equal to the weight of His Throne, and equal to the ink that may be used in recording the words for His Praise.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2726 — Read 3 times in evening
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٧٢٦ - تقرأ ٣ مرات في المساء

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2691 — Read 10 times in evening
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٦٩١ - تقرأ ١٠ مرات في المساء

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am bound to my covenant and promise to You as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6306 — Sayyid al-Istighfar (Master of Seeking Forgiveness)

items.text_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
items.text_en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
items.source_en: Sunan Abi Dawud 5072, Tirmidhi 3389 — Read 3 times
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٧٢، الترمذي ٣٣٨٩ - تقرأ ٣ مرات

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, I enter the evening and bear witness to You, and bear witness to the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and messenger.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
items.text_en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this evening or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, with no partner. To You belongs all praise and gratitude.

items.text_ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.text_en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. I have placed my trust in Him, and He is the Lord of the magnificent Throne.

items.text_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.text_en: We enter the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and the way of our father Ibrahim, inclining to truth and submitting, and he was not of the polytheists.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, grant my body well-being. O Allah, grant my hearing well-being. O Allah, grant my sight well-being. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You.

items.text_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.text_en: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Mighty, besides whom there is no god, the Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

items.text_ar: يَا رَبِّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
items.text_en: O my Lord, to You belongs all praise as is fitting for the majesty of Your Face and the greatness of Your dominion.

items.text_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.text_en: O Living, O Sustaining, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
items.text_en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, from the evil of Satan and his shirk, and from committing evil against myself or leading another Muslim to it.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.

items.text_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.text_en: I seek Allah's forgiveness.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 597 — Read 3 times after each prayer

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.text_en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes Peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of Majesty and Honor.

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give and none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the wealthy does not avail them before You.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.text_en: All praise is for Allah.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.text_en: Allah is the Greatest.

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things. (Completes the 100th after the 33x3 above)

items.text_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.text_en: Ayat al-Kursi (Quran 2:255) — Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. (Recite after every obligatory prayer)
items.source_en: Sunan an-Nasa'i — Whoever recites it after each prayer is kept from entering Paradise only by death
items.source_ar: سنن النسائي - من قرأها بعد كل صلاة لم يمنعه من الجنة إلا الموت

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Ikhlas (Quran 112) — Say: He is Allah, the One. (Recite after every obligatory prayer; 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi — Recite after every prayer; 3x after Fajr and Maghrib
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود - تقرأ بعد كل صلاة، ٣ مرات بعد الفجر والمغرب

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.text_en: Surah Al-Falaq (Quran 113) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. (Recite after every obligatory prayer; 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi — Recite after every prayer; 3x after Fajr and Maghrib
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود - تقرأ بعد كل صلاة، ٣ مرات بعد الفجر والمغرب

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.text_en: Surah An-Nas (Quran 114) — Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. (Recite after every obligatory prayer; 3 times after Fajr and Maghrib)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi — Recite after every prayer; 3x after Fajr and Maghrib
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود - تقرأ بعد كل صلاة، ٣ مرات بعد الفجر والمغرب

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things. There is no power and no might except with Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and we worship none but Him. To Him belongs the blessing, to Him belongs the favor, and to Him belongs all beautiful praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, making the religion sincerely for Him alone, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 594 — Narrated by Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٥٩٤ - عن عبد الله بن الزبير

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.text_en: Allah, there is no god but Him, the Living, the Sustainer. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. (Ayat al-Kursi)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 2311 — Read before sleep for protection from Satan
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٢٣١١ - تقرأ عند النوم لحماية من الشيطان

items.text_ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.text_en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You hold my soul, have mercy on it, and if You release it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6320, Muslim 2714 — Said before sleep
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٦٣٢٠، مسلم ٢٧١٤ - يقال عند النوم

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ. آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ، لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.text_en: The Messenger believes in what has been revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. All believe in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers. We make no distinction between any of His messengers. They say: We hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return. Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have the good it has earned, and it will bear the evil it has earned. Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden as You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Guardian, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people. (Last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 5009, Muslim 808 — Last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah (285-286), read before sleep
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٥٠٠٩، مسلم ٨٠٨ - آخر آيتين من سورة البقرة، تقرأ عند النوم

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak from the evil of whatever He has created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind. (Recite and wipe over the body 3 times)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 5017, Muslim 2192 — Recite into hands and wipe over body 3 times
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٥٠١٧، مسلم ٢١٩٢ - ينفث في كفيه ويمسح بها جسده ٣ مرات

items.text_ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.text_en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.text_en: All praise is for Allah.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.text_en: Allah is the Greatest.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, I submit my soul to You, entrust my affairs to You, direct my face to You, and seek refuge in my back with You, out of hope and fear of You. There is no refuge or escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent. (Said before sleep)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6313, Muslim 2714 — Said before sleep

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَهَا فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.text_en: O Allah, You created my soul and You take it back. If You keep it, then have mercy on it, and if You release it, then protect it as You protect Your righteous servants. (Said before sleep)

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَا عَبَدْتُمْ وَلَا أَنْتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship. Nor will I worship what you worship, nor will you worship what I worship. You have your religion, and I have my religion. (Surah Al-Kafirun)
items.source_en: Sunan Abi Dawud 5050, Tirmidhi 3403 — Read before sleep, it is a declaration of freedom from shirk
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٥٠، الترمذي ٣٤٠٣ - تقرأ عند النوم، براءة من الشرك

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْقُرْآنِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
items.text_en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the magnificent Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran. I seek refuge in You from the evil of all things, for You hold their forelock. O Allah, You are the First, so there is nothing before You. You are the Last, so there is nothing after You. You are the Manifest, so there is nothing above You. You are the Hidden, so there is nothing below You. Settle our debt and enrich us above poverty.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
items.text_en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, sufficed us, and sheltered us. How many are those who have none to suffice them and none to shelter them.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
items.text_en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, from the evil of Satan and his shirk, and from committing evil against myself or leading another Muslim to it.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.text_en: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
items.text_en: Praise is to Allah who has restored my body to health, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.
items.source_en: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3401 — Said upon waking up

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
items.text_en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they cover, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all those they mislead, Lord of the winds and all that they scatter. I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people, and the good of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and the evil of what is in it.
items.source_en: Al-Hakim (sahih) — Said when entering a town
items.source_ar: الحاكم وصححه - يقال عند دخول قرية أو بلدة

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.text_en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2708 — Said when stopping at a place
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٧٠٨ - يقال عند النزول في منزل

items.text_ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (عند الصعود)، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (عند الهبوط)
items.text_en: Allahu Akbar (when ascending), Subhanallah (when descending).
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري - جابر بن عبد الله

items.text_ar: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.text_en: A hearer has heard our praise of Allah for His good favors upon us. Our Lord, accompany us and bestow favors upon us, seeking refuge in Allah from the Fire.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim — Said by the Prophet during travel at dawn
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم - كان النبي يقوله إذا أسحر في سفر

items.text_ar: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ، زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ مَا كُنْتَ
items.text_en: I entrust Allah with your religion, your trust, and the concluding deeds of your actions. May Allah provide you with taqwa, forgive your sins, and facilitate goodness for you wherever you are.
items.source_en: Jami at-Tirmidhi — Said by resident to traveler

items.text_ar: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
items.text_en: I entrust you to Allah, whose trusts are never lost.
items.source_en: Musnad Ahmad (sahih) — Said by traveler to residents
items.source_ar: مسند أحمد - دعاء المسافر لمن يودعهم

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah. (Say when your mount or vehicle stumbles)
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٤٩٨٢ - يقال عند العثور بالدابة

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
items.text_en: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished it on our own. And to our Lord we shall surely return.
items.source_en: Quran 43:13-14 — Said when boarding a vehicle

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah. (Said before eating)

items.text_ar: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَذْكُرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.text_en: If one of you eats, let him mention the name of Allah. If he forgets to mention the name of Allah at the beginning, let him say: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٣٧٦٧ - إذا نسي التسمية في أوله

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.text_en: O Allah, bless for us what You have provided for us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.text_en: Praise is to Allah Who has fed me this and provided it for me without any strength or power on my part.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 3850, Tirmidhi 3458 (sahih) — Said after eating
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٣٨٥٠ - يقال بعد الطعام

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
items.text_en: Praise is to Allah, abundant, good, and blessed praise. A praise that is never insufficient, never abandoned, and never dispensed with. Our Lord.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
items.text_en: O Allah, bless for them what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy on them.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2042 — Said to the host after eating

items.text_ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.text_en: The thirst has gone, the veins have been moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 3849 (hasan) — Said after drinking
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٣٨٤٩ - يقال بعد الشرب

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلَبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ عَيْنٍ لَا تَدْمَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that is not humble, from an eye that does not weep, from a supplication that is not answered, and from a soul that is never satisfied.

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.text_en: There is no deity except You. Exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers. (Dua of Yunus, said in distress)
items.source_en: Quran 21:87, Tirmidhi 3505 — The Prophet said no Muslim says this except Allah relieves him

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Rectify all my affairs. There is no deity except You.

items.text_ar: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.text_en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.
items.source_en: Quran 3:173 — Said in times of fear and anxiety

items.text_ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.text_en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, compensate me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 918 — Said when afflicted with calamity

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty beyond anyone other than You.
items.source_en: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3563 — Dua for debt relief

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
items.text_en: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy. And You make hardship easy if You will.
items.source_en: Sahih Ibn Hibban 946 — Said when something is difficult
items.source_ar: صحيح ابن حبان ٩٤٦ - دعاء من استصعب عليه أمر

items.text_ar: قَدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
items.text_en: Allah has decreed, and whatever He wills, He does.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2664 — Said when something unwanted happens
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٦٦٤ - يقال عند حدوث ما لا يحب

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, suffice me against them with whatever You will.
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٧١٦ - دعاء من خاف ظلم قوم

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
items.text_en: O Allah, we place You before them and seek refuge in You from their evil.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 1535 (sahih) — Said when fearing a group
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٥٣٥ - كان النبي يقوله إذا خاف قوماً

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from stinginess and cowardice, and from the burden of debt and the domination of men.

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.text_en: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely. (Said when leaving the home)
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٩٦ - يقال عند الخروج من المنزل

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 5096 (sahih) — Said when leaving home

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from straying or being led astray, from slipping or being made to slip, from oppressing or being oppressed, from acting ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 5096, Tirmidhi 3427 (sahih) — Said when leaving home
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٩٦ - دعاء الخروج من المنزل

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah. (Said when entering the home)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6321 — Mention Allah's name when entering
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٦٣٢١ - يقال عند دخول المنزل

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ الْمَوْلِجِ وَخَيْرَ الْمَخْرَجِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خَيْبَةِ الْمَنْقَلَبِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You for the best of entering and the best of leaving. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a disappointing return.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 5096 (hasan) — Said when entering home
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٥٠٩٦ - دعاء دخول المنزل

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah cure you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2186 — Said to the sick

items.text_ar: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ، رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
items.text_en: I ask Allah the Mighty, the Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 3106 (sahih) — Said 7 times to the sick
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٣١٠٦ - تقال ٧ مرات للمريض

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.text_en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and cure. You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no trace of illness.

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.text_en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (Said 3 times morning and evening for protection)
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٧٠٩ - رقية النفس، تقال ٣ مرات

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Said 3 times for protection)
items.source_en: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3388 (sahih) — Said 3 times morning and evening
items.source_ar: سنن الترمذي ٣٣٨٨ - تقال ٣ مرات صباحاً ومساءً

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَذَرَأَ، وَبَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا
items.text_en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which no righteous or wicked person can transcend, from the evil of what He created, made, and originated, and from the evil of what descends from the sky and what ascends therein.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him. Glory be to Allah the Mighty.
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 6406 — Two words light on tongue, heavy on scale
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٦٤٠٦ - كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him is praise, and He is able to do all things.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2692 — Said 100 times, sins forgiven even if like sea foam

items.text_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.text_en: There is no god but Allah, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah.
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٦٦١٠ - كنز من كنوز الجنة

items.text_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.text_en: I seek Allah's forgiveness and repent to Him.

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.text_en: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 2695 — Most beloved words to Allah
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٦٩٥ - أحب الكلام إلى الله

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.text_en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.

items.text_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
items.text_en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
items.source_en: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3389 (sahih) — Said 3 times, Allah will please him on Day of Judgment

items.text_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.text_en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify for me all my affairs and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا نَعْلَمُهُ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا نَعْلَمُهُ
items.text_en: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and we seek Your forgiveness for what we do not know.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in the best manner.
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 1521 (sahih) — Said at end of every prayer
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٥٢١ - يقال بعد كل صلاة

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَالْهَرَمِ وَقَسْوَةِ الْقَلْبِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and stinginess, from old age and hardness of heart.

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
items.text_en: O Allah, forgive me all my sins, the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.

items.text_ar: يُجِيبُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ بِمِثْلِ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ
items.text_en: Repeat after the mu'adhin what he says. (When the mu'adhin says Hayya 'ala as-salah and Hayya 'ala al-falah, say La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah)

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.text_en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. (Said after hearing the adhan)

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.text_en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the praised station You have promised him. (Said after adhan)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 614 — Dua after adhan, then my intercession becomes lawful for him
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ٦١٤ - دعاء بعد الأذان، من قاله حلت له شفاعتي

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah. (Said before starting wudu)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 101, Tirmidhi 25 — Said before wudu
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٠١ - يقال قبل الوضوء

items.text_ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.text_en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger. (Said after completing wudu)
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 234 — Eight gates of Paradise opened for whoever says this after wudu
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٢٣٤ - تقال بعد الوضوء، تفتح له أبواب الجنة الثمانية

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
items.text_en: O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves. (Said after wudu)

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
items.text_en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no deity but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You. (Said after wudu)
items.source_en: Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sahih Ibn Hibban — Said after wudu

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy. (Said when entering the mosque)
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 487 — Said when entering the mosque
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٤٨٧ - يقال عند دخول المسجد

items.text_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.text_en: I seek refuge in Allah the Mighty, in His noble face, and in His eternal authority from the accursed Satan. (Said when entering the mosque)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 466 (sahih) — Said when entering mosque, Satan says: he is protected from me all day
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٤٦٦ - يقال عند دخول المسجد

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your mercy. (Said when entering the mosque)
items.source_en: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 3447 — Narrated from Fatimah (RA)
items.source_ar: مصنف ابن أبي شيبة ٣٤٤٧ - عن فاطمة رضي الله عنها

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. (Said when leaving the mosque)
items.source_en: Sahih Muslim 487 — Said when leaving the mosque
items.source_ar: صحيح مسلم ٤٨٧ - يقال عند الخروج من المسجد

items.text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَافْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ
items.text_en: In the name of Allah, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, forgive my sins and open for me the doors of Your bounty. (Said when leaving the mosque)
items.source_en: Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah 3447 — Narrated from Fatimah (RA)
items.source_ar: مصنف ابن أبي شيبة ٣٤٤٧ - يقال عند الخروج من المسجد

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil and from the male and female devils. (Said before entering the bathroom)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Muslim 375 — Said before entering bathroom
items.source_ar: صحيح البخاري ١٤٢ - يقال قبل دخول الخلاء

items.text_ar: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.text_en: I seek Your forgiveness. (Said when leaving the bathroom)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 30, Tirmidhi 7 — Said by the Prophet when leaving the bathroom
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٣٠ - يقال بعد الخروج من الخلاء

items.text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الْأَذَى وَعَافَانِي
items.text_en: Praise be to Allah who removed from me the discomfort and gave me relief. (Said when leaving the bathroom)
items.source_en: Sunan Ibn Majah 297 — Said when leaving the bathroom
items.source_ar: سنن ابن ماجه ٢٩٧ - يقال بعد الخروج من الخلاء

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
items.text_en: O Allah, distance me from my sins as You have distanced the East from the West. O Allah, cleanse me from my sins as a white garment is cleansed from dirt. O Allah, wash my sins with water, snow, and hail. (Opening dua of prayer)
items.source_en: Sahih al-Bukhari 744, Muslim 598 — Opening dua of prayer

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
items.text_en: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You. (Opening dua of prayer)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 775, Tirmidhi 243 (sahih) — Opening dua of prayer

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَمِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَمِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
items.text_en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the accursed Satan, from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness. (Said in prayer before recitation)

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
items.text_en: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless for me what You have bestowed, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none can decree over You. And whoever You take as a friend is not humiliated. Blessed are You, our Lord, and Exalted. (Qunut of Witr prayer)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 1425, Tirmidhi 464 — Qunut dua of Witr, taught by the Prophet to Hasan ibn Ali
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٤٢٥ - دعاء قنوت الوتر، علمه النبي للحسن بن علي

items.text_ar: سُبْحَانَ الْمَلِكِ الْقُدُّوسِ
items.text_en: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Holy. (Said after Witr prayer, raise voice on third time)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 1430, Nasa'i 1730 — Said 3 times after Witr
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٤٣٠ - تقال ٣ مرات بعد الوتر

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَارْفَعْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.text_en: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, support me, elevate me, guide me, grant me well-being, and pardon me. (Said between the two prostrations in prayer)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 850, Ibn Majah 897 (sahih) — Said between two prostrations
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ٨٥٠ - يقال بين السجدتين

items.text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.text_en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in the best manner. (Said at the end of prayer, before salam)
items.source_en: Sunan Abu Dawud 1521 (sahih) — Said at end of every prayer before salam
items.source_ar: سنن أبي داود ١٥٢١ - يقال في آخر كل صلاة قبل التسليم
